text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Another exciting race in the<n>bag!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! Be it a sprint or a<n>mile, you can
count on me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I get the feelin' I'll be winning a lot<n>more from here
on out!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep racin' and racin' till I<n>take home
the title of Umamusume of<n>the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But before that...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm throwin' a victory bash so good<n>it'll make your
head spin!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Yesterday's race and<n>party sure
were a hoot, weren't<n>they?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, where should I run next?<n>Whatever the race,
I'll ace it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We beat the odds to come out on top<n>at the Shinzan
Kinen. Now we need to<n>keep up this momentum and
take on<n>bigger challenges!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If Taiki wants the title of Umamusume<n>of the Year,
being selected for a URA<n>award is a must.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Considering her skillset, she'll need<n>to at least win
the Best Sprinter<n>Award, the true pinnacle of mile
and<n>sprint races.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On that note, the race that crowns the<n>classic King
of the Mile is coming up...
choice_data_list: Let's go to the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That's a G1 race, ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaw! Now there's a funrace—filled to the brim with plenty ofstrong Umamusume! It's already got my heart pounding!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All righty then—let's get to partyin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, Trainer. You've got it all<n>wrong.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
See, yesterday's shindig was for the<n>end of the
Shinzan Kinen! Today, I'm<n>celebratin' my new goal!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now that we're on the same page...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We gotta go buy some big cuts of<n>beef for the main
roast!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide on the NHK Mile<n>Cup, the race
that crowns the King of<n>the Mile for the classic year.
